description: XRP Ledger network health right now: latest validated ledger, close time, transactions and payments in it, fee levels, load, and rolling averages cross-checked against a direct ledger read. Useful before submitting XRP Ledger transactions or when reporting current network conditions. The first call each day returns the real answer without payment. After that, about $0.001 via x402 (USDC on Base, or XRP / RLUSD on the XRP Ledger). A payment watch is paid from the first call. Bad input and ledger outages are never charged.
name: ledger_pulse
title: Ledger Pulse
